summary: Agent Studio implements the full task/run/evidence chain; telemetry systems can carry lower-level traces but do not replace the delivery envelope.

items.text: Agent Studio uses TaskKey and TaskId as the correlation root, RunId for each execution, an ordered per-task timeline, payload references and a digest-bound immutable result envelope. Durable handoff recovery replays journaled transfer facts without restarting the coding agent.
OpenTelemetry provides interoperable trace and log correlation that can carry operation events beneath the task-level envelope.
SLSA provenance provides established vocabulary for binding immutable artifacts to a verifiable production process.
